{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Tessek-TVD.png|thumb|219x219px|Tessek served as an accountant]]
An '''accountant''' was responsible for recording the funds of an organization. A chief accountant's duties included administration of the annual dues of the organization. [[Samara Kebyc]] was the chief accountant for the [[Cloud City Miner's Guild]].<ref name="DB Kebyc">{{DB|character|kebyc|Kebyc}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] had several accountants, including the ill-fated [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] [[Lhojugg]],<ref name="Greedo's Tale WS">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/webstrips/greedo/index.html?show=1|text=A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale|int=A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale (webstrip)}}</ref> his successor of the same species, [[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Mosep Binneed]],<ref name="Greedo's Tale WS" /> the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Scrib Leras]],<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> and by the time of [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|his death]], the duplicitous [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Tessek/Legends|Tessek]].<ref name="Tessek's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=A Free Quarren in the Palace: Tessek's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>
